signals.headline: Inventory truth is the gate before omnichannel AI scale.
signals.body: BOPIS, ship-from-store, substitution, and exception prediction depend on item-location accuracy and store-task reliability.

move.title: at_risk decision for Retail lakehouse and customer inventory graph

signals.headline: Retail media value needs incrementality proof, not impression volume.
signals.body: Personalization and retail media should connect loyalty identity, consent, clean-room measurement, margin, and campaign lift.

move.title: scale_candidate decision for AI demand forecasting and replenishment

signals.headline: Shrink AI needs a connected evidence chain.
signals.body: POS exceptions, camera events, returns, inventory movement, and investigations must connect before loss-prevention AI can scale without customer friction.

move.title: hold_until_evidence decision for Store labor scheduling optimization

signals.headline: Store labor AI needs manager-ready guardrails.
signals.body: Scheduling and task optimization must respect labor rules, local constraints, and manager overrides to avoid brittle plans.

corpus.patternName: Omnichannel inventory truth before AI scale
corpus.whenToApply: Use when BOPIS, ship-from-store, and personalization depend on inventory accuracy.
